name: Processing
description: Processing is a flexible software sketchbook and language for learning how to code within the context of the visual arts. It is the premier tool for creative coding, generative art, and data visualization.

items.title: Processing Tutorials (Official)
items.description: Official tutorials covering everything from coordinate systems to 2D/3D transformations and hardware integration.

items.title: Getting Started with Processing
items.description: Official guide by the co-founders walking through syntax, concepts, and basics.

items.title: Processing Reference
items.description: Definitive cheatsheet and documentation for every built-in function and data type.

items.title: Processing Foundation
items.description: The non-profit organization supporting the Processing project and community.

items.title: Hello Processing
items.description: An interactive video introduction teaching fundamentals in about an hour.

items.title: The Coding Train (Daniel Shiffman)
items.description: The gold standard for creative coding instruction with hundreds of video tutorials and coding challenges.
